subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Does the exact merge result provide enough real upgrade and lifecycle evidence to ship the tracker-approved one-way SQLite flip safely?
rationale: Architecture and dependency contracts are supported; human judgment is still required to decide whether the evidence covers the migration's upgrade and cross-runtime blast radius.

options.title: Require inspectable exact-merge proof
options.body: Hold merge until a redacted artifact demonstrates legacy upgrade, restart, agent/channel and Codex continuity, compaction, archive/delete, recovery, and no active JSONL fallback.

options.title: Accept reported proof
options.body: Owners may accept the reported local smoke and hosted CI without a publicly inspectable runtime artifact.

options.title: Split for smaller proof units
options.body: Separate migration and integration surfaces if one artifact cannot convincingly establish the complete lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable exact-merge proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until a redacted artifact demonstrates legacy upgrade, restart, agent/channel and Codex continuity, compaction, archive/delete, recovery, and no active JSONL fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history owns the accessor and Plugin SDK contract at the center of the migration.
